title: Account Closure and Transfer Summary
brief: Draft an official account discontinuance summary and routing confirmation for back-office processing.

delegate.scenario: A retail bank customer representative took a walk-in request to close several personal deposit accounts and wire the remaining balances to an external institution. The representative needs to pass a clean, structured discontinuance ticket to the back-office operations team before the end of the day. Operations will execute the wire transfers and deactivate the account profiles based on this record.
delegate.inputs:
Customer: Marcus Vance | SSN Ref: XXX-XX-4819
Reason: Relocating out of state, requesting full service discontinuance.

Accounts to Close:
- Everyday Checking (#4082): Current balance $1,840.50. Pending debit card transaction of $45.00 at Shell Gas from 10/12/2023.
- Growth Savings (#9114): Current balance $12,450.00. Accrued monthly interest pending: $14.20.
- 12-Month CD (#2044): Balance $5,000.00. Maturity date: 11/15/2024. Customer elected immediate liquidation.

Transfer Routing Instructions:
- Recipient Institution: Horizon Community Bank
- Routing Number: 071000288
- Destination Account: 884019234
- Total requested payout: $19,290.50
- Forwarding Address: 442 Elm Ridge Way, Boise, ID 83702
- Written notice signed: Yes
- In-person ID verified: Current Idaho Driver's License
delegate.goal: Provide back-office operations with an accurate, unambiguous account discontinuance order that reconciles final disbursement balances and flags pending holds or premature closure conditions.

criteria.text: Identifies back-office deposit operations as the intended recipient and processing audience.
Specifies a concise, tabular or field-by-field format detailing account numbers, ledger actions, and routing targets.
Instructs the AI to verify the arithmetic of the total payout against individual account balances and adjustments.
Requires flagging any active transaction holds, pending interest, or early withdrawal terms before settlement.
Limits the response to internal bank documentation standards without including conversational filler.

traps.description: The requested total payout ignores the pending debit card transaction and pending interest, creating an incorrect total transfer sum.
The customer requests immediate liquidation of a certificate of deposit that matures in the future without accounting for early withdrawal penalties.
